title: Canonical diagram of stage etale section sets
statement: Let I be a preorder, D : I^op → Scheme, c a cone, i₀ : I, G a sheaf of sets (Type (u+1)) on D(i₀), and W₀ an etale object over D(i₀). Define a functor E : (Over(op i₀))^op → Type (u+1). Its value at op j is (D(j.hom)^*G)(W₀ × D(j.left)), and its map on the opposite of a : k → j is the canonical section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] for the commuting triangle D(k.left) → D(j.left) → D(i₀). Identity and composition equations are those of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison-laws]. This is a real construction, with no affine or limit hypothesis.

proof.text: Construct objects and transition maps using the canonical section comparison; the identity and composition clauses of the comparison laws supply the functor axioms.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YQ and 0EYL; Sites Tag 09YN; concrete functor and cocone formulation by M3. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YN and /tag/0EYL.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing canonical stage-section diagram or colimit theorem. ColimitSiteSections states evaluation commutes with filtered colimits of sheaves on one fixed site, rather than the varying-site section comparison needed here. ComparisonLaws supplies the concrete functor and cocone equations.
